scope: Two-iteration CP4/FSDP4 rank-32 DROID LoRA smoke training
summary: The first LoRA smoke run instantiated the correct 14B model, injected 143,917,056 trainable adapter parameters, and loaded all 172 training videos, but the first FSDP all-gather ran out of memory on shared physical GPU 0 by 758 MiB before producing a checkpoint.
evidence: The verified DROID base checkpoint and tokenizer loaded successfully on four selected physical GPUs.
LoRA injection reported 143,917,056 trainable parameters out of 14,409,202,688 total, with FSDP shard size 4 and context parallel size 4.
The dataset loader found exactly 172 videos, matching the immutable training split contract.
Rank 0 failed while allocating 758 MiB with 752 MiB physically free; PyTorch reported 1.96 GiB reserved but unallocated, indicating allocator fragmentation at a shared-card memory boundary.
No model checkpoint was written and result.json records PARTIAL.
lessons: The model and dataset contracts reach the actual FSDP training step, but the two partially occupied GPUs leave almost no allocator headroom.
Enable PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True before changing model or data semantics because the reported unused reserved memory exceeds the failed allocation.
limitations: No optimizer step completed, so this attempt is not training-quality evidence.
next_actions: Retry in a new directory with expandable CUDA segments; if it still fails, add activation checkpointing or reduce LoRA targets while preserving the native multiview dataset.
